title: Probe Catalog Stitcher and Onboarding Gatekeeper
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem:
The current profile publishing flow produces profiles that are brittle across small dataset or prompt changes. Onboarding new models often produces multiple near-duplicate profiles and inconsistent seed choices, which complicates version pinning and rollback. This ticket introduces a lightweight 'Probe Catalog Stitcher' to deterministically join sampled probes (datasets+prompt variants+runner configs) into canonical probe bundles, and an 'Onboarding Gatekeeper' that validates, locks, and signs profile artifacts before publishing to the catalog.

Goals:
- Produce deterministic, compact profile bundles that survive small dataset diffs.
- Ensure onboarding produces a single canonical profile per model-major-version that can be pinned by customers.
- Add gating checks (stability, regression, telemetry coverage) before publishing.
- Integrate with existing harness so that eval runners can rehydrate probe bundles for reproducible runs.

Success metrics:
- Reduce duplicate profiles on model onboarding by >= 70% within first month.
- Pinning/rollback flow tested end-to-end with 3 community models.
- Publishing latency (from finalize->catalog) < 5 minutes for typical profiles.

Design summary:
- Probe Catalog Stitcher: A deterministic assembler that accepts a set of scored probe candidates (prompt variants, dataset slices, runner configs) and emits a canonical bundle with fingerprinted artifacts and a stable ordering. Uses a hash-based stable sort with canonicalized prompt text and dataset slice identifiers. Will produce a small JSON lockfile (probe.lock) + artifact pointers (s3 path or internal blob id).
- Onboarding Gatekeeper: Validation pipeline that runs a short stability harness (5 deterministic seeds) and a lightweight regression comparer against a baseline profile. Gatekeeper enforces thresholds and either signs the bundle (catalog publish) or raises a deterministic failure with required mitigation steps.
- Profile lockfiles: Add schema versioning (v1) and include provenance fields: model, model_digest, harness_version, sampling_seed_bank_id, runner_snapshot.
acceptance_criteria: Probe Catalog Stitcher can create a probe.lock for a sample model with deterministic ordering across 3 runs
Onboarding Gatekeeper runs stability harness and rejects profiles that exceed regression thresholds
Published profile lockfiles appear in catalog with signed metadata and are retrievable by harness-runner with the same artifacts
Integration tests covering pin->rollback workflow using probe.lock pass in CI
Performance: average finalize->publish latency < 5 minutes for profiles < 200 probes
tasks: Implement canonicalizer for prompts and dataset slice IDs
Design probe.lock schema and add schema versioning
Hook stitcher into harness finalization step (finalize-profile command)
Implement gatekeeper validation checks and sign/publish step
Add unit and e2e tests for deterministic assembly and rehydration
Update docs: Confluence onboarding guide + API spec for probe.lock
Add telemetry events for publish latency, gatepass/fail reasons
comments: 2026-02-10 Maya Chen: Initial RFC drafted and posted to #model-onboarding. Key idea: compute canonical ordering using sha256(prompt_normalized + dataset_id) to avoid nondeterminism from set iteration.

2026-02-15 Lars Becker: Spike completed for canonicalizer; discovered corner case with whitespace-normalized prompts producing different semantics for code-generation prompts. Decided to include a 'preserve_whitespace' flag on prompt metadata for code-like prompts.
2026-02-18 Emily Patel (PM): Reviewed and requested explicit telemetry for 'seed variance' so product can monitor stability across seeds. Added to tasks.
2026-02-22 Implementation: stitcher prototype landed in feature/eng/stitcher-proto. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2498 - note: integration tests stubbed out.

2026-02-26 Review feedback from @security: confirm that signed metadata uses customer-specific KMS when publishing customer-private profiles. Gatekeeper will defer to customer's KMS binding when catalog.publish is called with private=true.

2026-03-01 Lars Becker: Gatekeeper prototype added. Stability harness runs with 5 seeds; initial regression comparator uses mean token-likelihood delta and emission divergence. Found one failing model due to quantization noise; created follow-up ENG-965433 to add quantization-aware comparator.

2026-03-03 Design review with DE and Research: agreed to include a lightweight 'explain' artifact in probe.lock that lists top-3 probes contributing to any detected regression to improve troubleshooting.

2026-03-05 QA: End-to-end smoke passed for two community models. Publishing latency median 3m12s on CI runner. Marking this ticket as In Progress with all core pieces implemented; polishing, docs, and tests remain.
notes: Trade-offs: Full deterministic replay is expensive; we opt for determinism at the probe-lock level (probe.lock) and allow runner-level nondeterminism when customers request stochastic checks.
Rollout plan: feature-flag gate for catalog publish; opt-in for first 2 weeks for dedicated/internal teams before enabling wide catalog visibility.
